asset.name: ScrollReveal
asset.description: The viewport-triggered presence component with a restrained replay policy, pooled observation, reduced-motion collapse, and content that remains visible without scripting.

requires.reason: Every spacing, size, and radius value resolves to a declared ramp rather than a literal.
Motion policy is resolved through the shared hook so the preference can be overridden and tested.
Enter and exit lifecycle, interruption, and nesting are owned once rather than per animated component.
Viewport observation is pooled rather than per-element.

rationale: Appropriate for the conversion-landing kit and almost never for operational surfaces, where content appearing on scroll reads as slowness rather than polish.
